zero_handling: Native exporter maps append/output lengths to minimum 1
sampling: All released sessions and calls; no windows or session sampling
timing: Native defaults: shuffled seed 0, Poisson arrivals 1 session/s, summed wall tool waits; no clipping or scaling
evaluation: Bounded 600s warmup + 1200s measurement. Session arrivals beyond 1800s and not-yet-submitted calls remain unissued. Calls already submitted drain to completion.
